findings.reason: C1 is the LDO 100 nF output bypass, not an MCU pin decap; the checker compares it to the nearest +3V3 pin, which is not its function.

findings.reason: C3 is the 22 uF LDO output bulk capacitor; its role is regulator stability, so the 100 mil IC-decap heuristic does not apply.

findings.recheck_condition: recheck if the rail shows transient noise

findings.reason: 128 mil is 28 mil over the heuristic; this decouples a low-power I2C sensor, not a high-speed core rail.

findings.reason: A local all-layer no-copper region under the antenna is present; the CLI warns because its expected shape is the full board-edge band. No copper was placed under the antenna.
findings.recheck_condition: re-measure with a full-band keepout or confirm with RF test

findings.reason: +3V3 is a low-current rail carried by sized tracks; the board keeps a solid GND pour. Pouring +3V3 was not justified by current.
findings.recheck_condition: recheck under measured load and voltage-drop test

findings.reason: The 10 mil GND segments are stubs into the double-sided GND pour; the return current is carried by the pour, not the thin stubs.
findings.recheck_condition: recheck return path if the pour is removed or the current increases

findings.reason: JLC panel rails add fiducials; the per-board 3-mark requirement was not applied to this prototype. Accepted with panel-maker responsibility.
